Alex: Morning check-in for the 06:00→14:00 window. Quick items:
Alex: 1) Feature flag rollout for /recommendations been moving slowly — we're at 10% traffic. No errors in prod but latency is ~30% higher on the model path. Watch RT and token-cost dashboard.
Alex: 2) A/B config: `recommend-v2` enabled in EU only. If you see >2s tail latencies, consider reverting the flag to `off`.
Alex: 3) CI flakes: two flaky tests in `serving/runtime` - I filed RED-OPS-834. Not blocking the shift.
Maria: Noted. I'll keep an eye on EU region dashboards and alerts. :eyes:
Jamal: Can you paste the revert command? I can stand by to flip if we see issues.
Alex: Sure — to revert:
```
# toggle feature flag
redwoodctl flags set recommend-v2 off --env=prod --region=eu
```
Alex: After revert, ping @deploy-bot so autoscaler cooldown doesn't get confused.
Sophie: I saw a couple of 502s in the metrics earlier around 05:40, likely from a small infra migration. Logs show NLB healthcheck timeouts. I restarted the target group; rates dropped. Not seeing ongoing errors now.
Maria: Good catch. Which service was the target?
Sophie: `edge-router-eu`. I left a short note in the infra ticket: RED-OPS-835.
Jamal: I'll schedule an A/B run for the recommend-v2 in canary (10 req/s) around 07:15 to look at p95 changes. Will post results.
oncall-bot: Shift swap reminder — @Maria takes 06:00→10:00, @Jamal takes 10:00→14:00. Please acknowledge with :thumbsup:.
Maria: Ack :thumbsup:
Jamal: Ack :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: model-serving patch 2026-03-18T06:30Z (non-breaking). Will only proceed after manual confirm from oncall if latency > threshold.
Alex: Action items:
Alex: - Maria: monitor EU model p50/p95 and token cost, escalate if p95 > 2s or error rate > 0.5%
Alex: - Jamal: run the canary at 07:15, share p50/p95 + token-usage snapshot in this thread
Alex: - Sophie: follow up on RED-OPS-835 and confirm NLB healthcheck config is stable
Alex: If anything unexpected, call the bridge. Otherwise small ops window later today at ~13:00 for a non-urgent infra config sync.
Maria: One more note — feature-flag metrics in Datadog have a slight delay (approx 90s). Use raw traces for immediate verification.
Jamal: Copy that. I'll pull traces if p95 moves.
Sophie: I'll add a short postmortem stub in the infra ticket if the NLB behavior reoccurs.
Alex: Thanks — leaving this thread open for updates. :coffee:
